meta.name: poetry-music-visual
meta.description: 为古诗词提供配图与配乐的全流程创作指导；支持深度解析诗词意境、生成画面描述、提供配乐创作蓝图（Suno格式）；适用于诗词可视化、MV创作、文化传播等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为古诗词生成配图与配乐创作方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把古诗词转化为视听作品
copy.tagline_en: Generate visual and music creation plans for classical poetry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform classical poetry into audiovisual works

howto.what: 收到一首古诗词后,Claude 会先解析意象、情感、背景,再产出 2-3 组配图场景描述,并给出 Suno 格式的配乐创作蓝图(风格标签+结构指令),最后检查风格一致性。
howto.when: 当用户要求为某首古诗词配图、配乐或制作诗词 MV 时触发;即给出诗词并请求视觉/听觉转换。

say.text: 给李白《静夜思》配一幅图和一段纯音乐
say.note: 会解析诗意,产出画面描述和 Suno 蓝图。

say.text: 用王维《山居秋暝》做水墨配图,再写配乐结构
say.note: 会调整风格并输出对应配乐蓝图。

say.text: 把《春江花月夜》解析后做成 MV 分镜和音乐方案
say.note: 会给出整合的视听创作指导。

howto.what_en: Given a classical Chinese poem, it first analyzes imagery, emotion, and background, then produces 2-3 image-scene descriptions and a Suno-format music blueprint (style tags + structure), finally checking visual-audio consistency.
howto.when_en: It triggers when a user asks to add images, music, or a music-video treatment to a classical Chinese poem—i.e., when a poem is provided with a request for visual/audio conversion.

say_en.text: Create an illustration and a piece of instrumental music for Li Bai's 'Quiet Night Thought'.
say_en.note: It will analyze the poem, then output scene descriptions and a Suno blueprint.

say_en.text: Analyze 'A Moonlit Night on the Spring River' and design a music-video storyboard plus music plan.
say_en.note: It will give integrated audiovisual creation guidance.
